notes: One undated handwritten planning sheet on printed INSTITUT / DES HAUTES ÉTUDES SCIENTIFIQUES stationery. The label SGA 7 sits inside a faint loop. A short brace groups the first two entries, which give numbered references and an appendix described as la lettre Deligne 2 pages. A long brace groups notes on an appendix and comments concerning torsion and crystalline cohomology; a slanted left-margin question proposes an exposé XXIII. The author’s explicit doubt marks are the free question mark after the numerical range, Refaire 1.14 ?, the parenthesized (?) beside XXII, and the margin’s final question mark. Reader uncertainties are separate and remain marked at the initial Roman numeral, the connector, apres/après, relation/relations, and Commentaires/Commentaire. There is no date, signature, or manuscript page number. SGA 7 is the only subject label; the institution’s name is printed stationery. The visible 76 is treated as the archive sheet number, not as an authorial pagination; 2 pages is part of the Deligne entry. The heavy first numeral has retraced strokes but reveals no independently legible cancelled underlying text. No insertion or struck-through passage is visible. H’s editorial cross-reference to other pages is not manuscript text and was not followed. This run uses only the assigned packet and its three images. All thirteen crops were viewed once, with no truncation, recovery, reopening, or recropping; processing details are retained in processing.json and in the crops array.
math_reading_decisions: Confirmed unmarked C-context targets from the completed half-a reading: the dotted references 1.11, both occurrences of 1.14, and 1.15. The last reference was still open and was settled by crop 04 as 1.22. Each separator is a low point; the range contains a short unheaded horizontal dash, not an arrow. H’s -- versus C’s math minus-like dash is treated as rendering of the same handwritten dash, not a substantive difference.

The second-entry VI, third-entry XXI, and fourth-entry XXII were read independently from their strokes on half a. The margin’s XXIII was settled by the single rotated crop 13. Each has upper and lower transverse rules. The first Roman numeral remains VI/VII; no other numeral is normalized against it.

Free question marks occur after the first range and after Refaire 1.14. The fourth-entry question mark has both enclosing parentheses. The slanted margin question ends with its own question mark; these are not primes or exclamation marks.
The abbreviation coh. has an explicit period. It is preserved and not expanded in the transcription.

The slanted marginal exposé was checked in crop 12: e loop, crossed x, descending p, low o/s/e sequence, and a separate rising acute accent. It agrees with both witnesses; no uncertainty is retained. Faire un and the final question mark were already settled in the half reading and were not cropped again.

The printed rule, enclosing loop, and both grouping braces are represented by the retained exact LaTeX graphics. There are no mathematical diagrams or proof claims on the sheet. The Roman and reference-number checks are palaeographic collation, not proof or computation checks.
